title: SEE 2081 (2025) Computer Science (Optional Second) - RE-3031
sourceNote: Transcribed and translated in full to English from a scanned SEE 2081 (2025) Computer Science (Optional Second) question paper, code RE-3031. The paper itself printed both Nepali and English versions of each question; only the English wording is used here. The paper did not state which province issued it, so the 'province' field is left null - please confirm and fill it in. The 'examBoard' field is set to the generic 'SEE' as no specific board name was printed. No figures, flowcharts, or diagrams appeared anywhere in this paper, so no items include an image field. Question 7's printed code uses the variable C$ inside FUNCTION COUNT(A$), which does not match the declared parameter A$ - this looks like an OCR/printing error and has been preserved as printed (not silently corrected); see the corresponding answer item and the chat message for the suggested fix. Full marks (50) reconcile exactly against the printed section-wise marks breakdown (Group A = 10, Group B = 24, Group C = 16).

blocks.heading: SEE 2081 (2025) Computer Science - Optional Second
blocks.paragraph: This is the Secondary Education Examination (SEE) 2081 (2025 AD) question paper for Computer Science, Optional Second subject, paper code RE-3031. The paper carries full marks of 50 and an allotted time of 2 hours, and is divided into three groups: Group A (short, one-line answers and terminology), Group B (short/medium answer questions including QBASIC program tracing and debugging), and Group C (numerical conversions and full program-writing questions in QBASIC and C).

questionSections.title: Group B - Q5: Dry run the given program

items.question: Write down the output of the given program and show it in a dry run table.
items.code:
DECLARE SUB Display (T$)
T$="COMPUTER"
CALL Display (T$)
END

SUB Display (T$)
  FOR C=1 TO LEN (T$) STEP 2
    D$=MID$ (T$,C,1)
    PRINT D$;
  NEXT C
END SUB

questionSections.title: Group B - Q7: Study the given program and answer the questions

items.question: Write down the missing statement in the main module needed to execute the program.
items.code:
DECLARE FUNCTION COUNT (A$)
CLS
INPUT "Enter any word";W$
END

FUNCTION COUNT (A$)
  B=LEN(A$)
  C=0
FOR i=1 TO B
  E$=MID$(C$,i,1)
  IF E$="A" OR E$="E" OR E$="I" OR E$="O" OR E$="U" THEN
  C=C+1
  END IF
NEXT i
COUNT=C
END FUNCTION
items.ocrFlag: The printed line 'E$=MID$(C$,i,1)' uses C$, which is not declared anywhere (the function parameter is A$). This looks like an OCR/print error for A$; preserved here exactly as scanned rather than silently corrected - please check the original paper. See the answers file for the suggested correction.

questionSections.title: Group C - Q8: Convert/Calculate as per the instruction
Group C - Q9: Answer the following questions

items.question: Write a program in QBASIC that asks the length, breadth and height of a room and calculates its perimeter and volume. Create a Function procedure to calculate the perimeter and a Sub procedure to calculate the volume. [HINT: Volume = L x B x H and Perimeter = 2(L+B)]

A sequential data file "std.dat" stores some students' name, roll number, and marks in English, Nepali, Maths and Computer. Write a program to read data from the sequential data file named "std.dat" and display all the information of those students whose marks in Computer is more than 40.

questionSections.title: Group C - Q10: Write a program (attempt either option)

items.question: Write a program in C-language to find the greatest number among any two different input numbers.
OR: Write a program in C-language to display the series 5, 10, 15, 20, ... up to the 15th term.
